name: Property Owners Task Force Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Property Owners Task Force Committee
  Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Tuesday, March 19, 2024
  4:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  March 19, 2024 / 4:00 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Councilmember Lili Bosse, Councilmember Sharona Nazarian, Community
  Outreach Manager Magdalena Davis, Director of Community Development
  Michael Forbes, Beverly Hills Chamber of Commerce President and CEO
  Todd Johnson, Beverly Hills Chamber of Commerce Director of Economic
  Development & Government Affairs Brittany Ganson, Beverly Hills
  Chamber of Commerce Government Affairs Consultant Ted Green, Los
  Angeles County Economic Development Corporation Vice President of
  Workforce Development and Special Projects Jermaine Hampton

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Welcome & Introductions:
  a. Michael Farahnik: Starpoint Properties
  b. David Mirharooni: Brickstar Capital
  c. Bill Wiley: Two Rodeo Drive
  d. Dar Mahbouti: Property Owner
  e. Alex Lahijani: Property Owner
  f. Ali Vahdani: Principle

  3) LAEDC Presentation on Major Upcoming Regional Sports & Entertainment Events:
  a. Presentation by Jermaine Hampton
  i. LACEDC is a nonprofit organization designed to help improve the
  economy of LA County.
  ii. LA County has nine major professional sports teams that bring in large
  amounts of capital through routine sporting events.
  iii. LA County also has attracted numerous high profile sporting events in the
  coming years that will spur large amounts of economic activity such as the
  2026 World Cup, 2026 NBA All-Star Game, 2027 Super Bowl LXI, and the
  2028 Summer Olympics.
 Highlights for March 19, 2024
Property Owners Task Force Committee

  iv. Beverly Hills is also situated near several high-profile studios which also
  serve as an economic stimulus for the city.
  v. Some economic challenges businesses face in leveraging these
  opportunities are high operating costs, competition with other businesses,
  and traffic.
  vi. Beverly Hills can leverage these economic opportunities by supporting
  conferences and networking events, promoting local businesses such as
  luxury retail and high-end hospitality, and by partnering with local
  entertainment and sports academies to support emerging talent.
  vii. Additional possibilities include film and event hosting, investment and
  sponsorship opportunities, and public relations and marketing.
  b.  Councilmember Nazarian was interested in both promoting Beverly Hills as the
  safest place in LA County as well as facilitating transportation between the sporting
  event sites and the city, with potential options including a temporary shuttle
  between the sites and the city.
  c.  The city is very aware of these opportunities and is working to take advantage of
  them.
  d.  Property owners can look at what sectors are prominent in the city and reorient
  their properties and office spaces to take advantage of them.
  e.  Most problems with utilizing vacant spaces on South Santa Monica and parts of
  Wilshire are due to restrictions from landlords, not from the city.

  4) Information Sharing & Discussion:
  a. Two of the property owners were in favor of charging at least a dollar an hour at
  the parking structures that have the first two hours free, while the rest are opposed
  to it and say it will deter potential shoppers and have negative effects on the nearby
  doctors’ offices as well.
  b. The city is currently in the process of upgrading the façade and interior of the
  existing parking structures at the recommendation of this task force.

  5) Future Agenda Items Discussion:
  a. None

  6) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: March 19, 2024 / 5:11 PM
